rows:
Query live ArcGIS services from user-supplied URLs, for public agencies and organizations worldwide. Feature scans support attribute and spatial filters. Explicit server-side counts and grouped numeric summaries avoid downloading whole layers; their source filters use ArcGIS SQL and spatial semantics. Imagery access samples pixel values at batches of WGS84 points, retaining multiband and NoData values as text. Raster files are not downloaded or exposed as feature views. Public services need no credentials; secured services use scoped ArcGIS secrets. 

# VGI ArcGIS worker

**Query live ArcGIS FeatureServer and MapServer layers from DuckDB SQL.** Attach the worker with a `url` option and every feature layer it finds becomes a view with a `GEOMETRY` column.

- `url` a services directory (`.../arcgis/rest/services`, one schema per service), a service (`.../FeatureServer`, one view per layer) or a single layer (`.../FeatureServer/0`).
- `url` may also be an ArcGIS Hub / Open Data site (`https://gis.data.ca.gov`, one schema per service in its catalog) or one of its dataset pages (`.../datasets/<itemId>_0`, resolved to the REST layer).
- `precision` decimal places kept in coordinates (default 7, about 1 cm).
- `arcgis.main.arcgis_query(url)` reads any layer by URL without attaching it.
- Token-secured services: ATTACH with `token`, `username` + `password`, or `client_id` + `client_secret` (secret options, redacted from `duckdb_databases()`), or create an `arcgis` secret scoped to a URL prefix for `arcgis_query`. Generated tokens are renewed automatically. In the DuckDB CLI, `getenv()` keeps a credential out of the SQL text:

```sql
ATTACH 'arcgis' AS gis (TYPE vgi, LOCATION '/path/to/vgi-arcgis-worker',
  url 'https://gis.example.gov/arcgis/rest/services', token getenv('ARCGIS_TOKEN'));
CREATE SECRET gis_token (TYPE arcgis, TOKEN getenv('ARCGIS_TOKEN'),
  SCOPE 'https://gis.example.gov/arcgis/rest/services/');
```

Simple filters (numeric comparisons, string equality and IN, IS NULL, prefix matches) and spatial filters against a constant (`geometry && <box>`, `ST_Intersects`, `ST_Within`, ...) run on the ArcGIS server; every filter is also applied exactly in the worker.

rows.vgi.doc_llm:
Query live ArcGIS services from user-supplied URLs, for public agencies and organizations worldwide. Feature scans support attribute and spatial filters. Explicit server-side counts and grouped numeric summaries avoid downloading whole layers; their source filters use ArcGIS SQL and spatial semantics. Imagery access samples pixel values at batches of WGS84 points, retaining multiband and NoData values as text. Raster files are not downloaded or exposed as feature views. Public services need no credentials; secured services use scoped ArcGIS secrets. Query ArcGIS REST feature services (FeatureServer and MapServer layers published through ArcGIS Server, ArcGIS Online and ArcGIS Hub) from DuckDB SQL. `main.arcgis_query(url)` reads one layer or table: attribute fields become typed columns and geometry becomes a `geometry` GEOMETRY column (WGS84). Attach with a `url` option to get views instead: a services directory URL gives one schema per service and one view per layer, a service URL gives one view per layer in `main`, a layer URL gives one view. An ArcGIS Hub / Open Data site URL (e.g. `https://gis.data.ca.gov`) works like a services directory: one schema per feature or map service in the site's catalog, named after the item title. A Hub dataset page URL (`https://<site>/datasets/<itemId>_<n>`, `.../datasets/<itemId>` or `.../datasets/<orgKey>::<slug>`) is resolved to the REST layer or service behind it, in ATTACH and in `arcgis_query`. Simple WHERE predicates and spatial filters against a constant (`geometry && <box>`, ST_Intersects, ST_Within, ...) run on the ArcGIS server, and results page automatically; the `precision` ATTACH option (default 7) sets how many decimals coordinates keep. Data is read live on every query. Token-secured services need credentials: the secret ATTACH options `token`, `username` + `password` or `client_id` + `client_secret` (an ArcGIS OAuth app) apply to the ATTACH `url`'s server, and list its secured services as views. Or create a DuckDB secret of type `arcgis` (fields TOKEN, or USERNAME and PASSWORD, or CLIENT_ID and CLIENT_SECRET, plus a SCOPE URL prefix), which `arcgis_query` uses for URLs under the scope but which catalog listings cannot see:

```sql
CREATE SECRET gis (TYPE arcgis, TOKEN getenv('ARCGIS_TOKEN'), SCOPE 'https://gis.example.gov/arcgis/rest/services/');
```

ATTACH credentials win over a secret. Errors 498/499 mean a missing, invalid or expired token.
